text:
Zoe: quick discussionwe keep getting PM asks: when saving a per-route view, the UI should recommend which model to make the default based on routing policies + quota. can we build a small "default model suggester" so users don't accidentally pick an expensive primary?

Priya: solid. suggestions should be explainable though. "Pick: 4o-q4 (saves ~70% cost)" is fine but include reason: capacity vs cost vs fidelity tradeoff.

Marco: backend implications: we need to combine three things: rollout config, recent route model usage (7d sample), and quota/commit tiers for org. that's a join of routing-config + telemetry + billing data. cheap approach: precompute suggestion per route nightly.

Dan: UX proposal: during save flow we show a compact pane with 3 cards: Suggested, Conservative, High-fidelity. Each card shows model, estimated tokens/day, est cost/day, likely fallback chain, and a one-line rationale. user can pick or keep custom. minimal friction. :rocket:

Zoe: love it. also add a toggle "always apply suggestion" per-team; make default off. we shouldn't silently change people's defaults.

Priya: API contract idea: GET /v1/savedviews/suggest?route_id=RID&team_id=TID returns suggestion blob. example payload: 

```
GET /v1/savedviews/suggest?route_id=r-77&team_id=t-9
200 OK
{
  "suggestions": [
    {"type":"suggested","model":"redwood/4o-q4","est_cost_per_1000":0.45,"est_p95_ms":140,"rationale":"~70% lower token cost, identical accuracy for short prompts"},
    {"type":"conservative","model":"redwood/4o-q6","est_cost_per_1000":0.30,"est_p95_ms":180,"rationale":"lower cost for high qps, good fallback profile"},
    {"type":"high_fidelity","model":"redwood/4o","est_cost_per_1000":1.40,"est_p95_ms":120,"rationale":"best latency/accuracy when fidelity matters"}
  ],
  "refresh_after": 3600
}
```

Marco: I think est_cost_per_1000 should be transparent about assumptions (avg tokens per call). backend should include `assumptions` field referencing tokens-per-call estimate and sample window. keep values conservative.

Dan: UI note: show small info icon with a popover explaining "These are estimates based on your route's recent traffic and org commit tier." link to "how cost is estimated" doc.

Zoe: security/privacy: ensure suggestions don't leak other customers' model usage. use aggregated org-level stats only. Ops teams, any concerns?

OpsBot: Automated check: suggestion computation will read telemetry aggregates (no raw logs), rollout-config, and billing tier. Access: service-account only. Audit event will be emitted for suggestion generation.

Priya: rollout plan: start as an opt-in flag for a couple of customers, measure acceptance rate of suggestions and whether default changes cause cost regressions. have guardrail to block suggesting >X% cost increase for teams without high commit.

Marco: infra plan: nightly job that writes suggestions into route-index->savedview_suggestions. Add TTL and an on-demand endpoint to recalc (rate-limited).

Dan: prototype timeline: I can build the save-flow UI in the sprint if API mock exists. Zoe can coordinate PM trials.

Zoe: assign owners: Marco (backend suggester + infra), Dan (UI), Priya (policy + docs), me (PM + customer trials). check-in Friday.

Priya: one more: add metric events: suggestion_shown, suggestion_accepted, suggestion_ignored, suggestion_rejected_reason. helps evaluate UX.
